item.text: I have enough material in hand to synthesize. I’m not searching further; I’m selecting the strongest claim-level items on correction, course changes, and implementation discipline.

**8B.8 Research Note: Srettha Thavisin in 2024**

Overall: mixed, leaning negative. There was some real adaptation, mostly in staffing and in partial redesign of the digital-wallet program, but the dominant pattern is late, partial, and reactive correction rather than sustained course correction that reliably fixed weak execution.

**Positive / corrective evidence**
- [Thai ex-executive Pichai named finance minister, faces growth challenge](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thai-exexecutive-pichai-named-finance-minister-faces-growth-challenge-3401984) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-28: Srettha moved a technocratic adviser with Stock Exchange of Thailand and Bank of Thailand background into Finance and Deputy PM, which is the clearest staffing correction in the economic core. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`
- [Cabinet changes / reshuffle announcement](https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/52/iid/283531) - Thailand Public Relations Department, 2024-04-29: The reshuffle changed Finance, Public Health, and deputy PM posts, showing a willingness to reset the team rather than leave the same lineup in place. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`
- [Summary of Weekly Press Briefing 19 April 2024](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/weeklypressbriefing190424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-04-19: Thailand created a special committee to monitor the Myanmar situation, which is evidence of procedural adaptation and institutionalized crisis management. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`
- [Thailand border delegation to Mae Sot](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/dpmfm-dpmim-dm-nscsg-maesot-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-04-23: A high-level civilian-security delegation was sent to coordinate support at the border, indicating a coordinated response after spillover risk became visible. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`
- [Thai PM says digital wallet scheme will spur jobs and manufacturing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-digital-wallet-scheme-will-spur-jobs-and-manufacturing-3514879) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-07-11: After criticism, Srettha re-framed the handout as jobs-and-manufacturing stimulus, which is weak but real rhetorical course correction. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`
- [Thai PM says part of $13 billion digital wallet stimulus to be in cash](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-part-of-13-billion-digital-wallet-stimulus-to-be-in-cash-3597164) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-03: The government shifted part of the program into cash payments, which is the clearest substantive redesign I found and does count as partial reallocation of method. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`
- [Thailand ratifies disappearance treaty / anti-torture law](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/icpped140524-2?page=5d5bd3da15e39c306002aaf9) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand, 2024-05-16: The government translated rights rhetoric into legal machinery meant to constrain abuse, which looks like structural correction rather than mere talk. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`

**Negative / failure-to-correct evidence**
- [Thailand's flagship $14 billion handout scheme suffers early snags as millions rush to register](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html) - Reuters via Yahoo News, 2024-08-01: The rollout still had registration snags and delays after months of criticism, suggesting the delivery pipeline remained unstable rather than corrected. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`
- [Thai central bank holds key rate, defies government calls for cuts](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-04-10: Srettha kept pressing the Bank of Thailand even as it resisted, which looks more like repeated pressure on an independent institution than adaptive learning. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.4`, `8B.6`
- [Forty Thai senators seek PM's dismissal over cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/forty-thai-senators-seek-pms-dismissal-over-cabinet-appointment/2089532/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-05-17: The Pichit Chuenban appointment drew a formal challenge, showing that Srettha had not yet corrected a politically connected staffing mistake. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`
- [Thai court says PM Srettha violated rules on ethics in cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-says-pm-srettha-violated-rules-on-ethics-in-cabinet-appointment/2222960/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-14: The ethics ruling and dismissal show that the appointment problem persisted all the way to removal, which is strong evidence against effective self-correction. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`
- [Analysis: political turmoil threatens prospects of Thailand's floundering economy](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysispolitical-turmoil-threatens-prospects-of-thailands-floundering-economy-3573010) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-08-15: Reuters linked the handout delay and coalition turmoil to a fragile governing machine, implying limited ability to sustain corrective coordination. QIDs: `8B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.7`

**Search gap**
- I did not find a public implementation dashboard, after-action review, or internal cabinet performance tracker that would let me verify systematic course correction. The evidence is therefore mostly ad hoc: staffing changes, one policy redesign, and crisis management in Myanmar, rather than a full record of disciplined iterative adaptation.
